file: env DB_PATH, default backend/data/pm.db (created, with tables and seed data, if it does not exist)

columns.password_hash: TEXT (scrypt$<cost>$<salt hex>$<hash hex>; NULL only in a version 1 database before its first start)

users.notes: Users register with a username matching ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,32}$ and a password of 8 to 128 characters. The demo user 'user' / 'password' is created on startup if missing.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.name: TEXT NOT NULL (1 to 60 characters, trimmed)
columns.data: TEXT NOT NULL (JSON document, see board_data)

boards.notes: Any number of boards per user. Every query is scoped by user_id. Version 1 had UNIQUE(user_id) and no name; init_db rebuilds that table (see DATABASE.md).

board_data.description: Stored in boards.data. Same shape as the frontend BoardData type, so the API, the UI and the AI all use one format.
rules: columns has exactly 5 entries with the fixed ids col-backlog, col-discovery, col-progress, col-review, col-done; only title changes
every card id appears in exactly one column's cardIds, and every cardIds entry exists in cards
cards is keyed by card id; the key equals the card's id field
title is non-empty; details may be an empty string
card order within a column is the order of cardIds
priority, due_date and labels are optional; missing means null, null and []

card-1.title: Align roadmap themes
card-1.details: Draft quarterly themes with impact statements and metrics.
